violation_type.title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly (26 TAC §747.5337(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly
violation_type.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed monthly carbon detection checks.

finding_variants.text: The permit holder has not completed monthly carbon detection checks.
Provider did not have documentation that Carbon Monoxide testing had been conducted monthly.
There was no documentation showing the carbon monoxide had been tested monthly as required.During the inspection the primary caregiver tested the carbon monoxide.
Operation did not have a carbon monoxide checklist for CCR to view.
At time of inspection, no documentation was available for monthly carbon monoxide alarm.     At time of inspection, no documentation was available for monthly fire extinguisher.
The operation did not have the monthy carbon monoxide checklist to review.
